6041.d: Täidlase suuga naise poolfiguur poolprofiilis vasemale; pea kerge kaldega vasemale, meelekohtadel lokid. Peas lõua alt roosa paelaga seotud pitstanu; seljas tumedate laiade käiste ja rüüžpitsidega rinnaesisel ja õlgadel, kaelas kroogitud pitskrae. Taust tume.
6041.de: Half-figure of a full-mouthed woman in semi-profile to the left; head slightly tilted to the left, curls at the temples. On her head a lace bonnet tied under the chin with a pink ribbon; wearing [a garment] with dark wide sleeves and ruche lace on the chest and shoulders, a gathered lace collar at the neck. Dark background.

6324.d: Valges lõua alt sõlmitud tanuga vanema naise rinnapilt peaaegu en face. Seljas valge kraega tumeroheline rüü.
6324.de: A bust portrait of an older woman wearing a white bonnet tied under the chin, almost en face. Wearing a dark green robe with a white collar.

6586.d: Mehe täisfiguur, poolprofiilis paremale, paremas käes valged kindad, kõrgeis säärikuis, taustaks maastik veekogu ja lossiga.
6586.de: Full figure of a man, in half-profile facing right, white gloves in his right hand, in tall boots, with a landscape with a body of water and a castle as background.

7202.d: Mehe poolfiguur poolprofiilis paremale, hallide kammitud juustega, paljakspöetud näoga; käed rinnal ristatud; seljas punakas kuub karusnahkse kraega; kaelas hele, lõuani mähitud sõlmside. Kujutis ovaalis.
7202.de: Half-figure of a man in half-profile to the right, with combed grey hair, a clean-shaven face; arms crossed on the chest; wearing a reddish coat with a fur collar; a light-coloured cravat wound up to the chin around the neck. The depiction is in an oval.

7210.d: Vanema naise portree kerge pöördega vasakule. Seljas oliivroheline samet kleit pitskraega. Peas pitstanu. Ülevaku õla punane rätt. Kujutis ovaalis.
7210.de: Portrait of an elderly woman with a slight turn to the left. Wearing an olive green velvet dress with a lace collar. On her head a lace cap. Over her shoulder a red shawl. The image is in an oval.

7548.d: Esiplaanil vasakult paremale suunduvad põlluribad. Nende taga puude vahel punaste ja hallide katustega majadegrupp. Taga silmapiiril sinakad künkad.
7548.de: In the foreground strips of field running from left to right. Behind them, among trees, a group of houses with red and grey roofs. Behind, on the horizon, bluish hills.

7549.d: Toolil istuva keskealise naise poolfiguur, keha kerge pöördega vasemale, pea en face. Käed vaheliti rinnal. Seljas valge pitskaelusega kleit, peas valge pitstanu siniste paeltega.
7549.de: Half-figure of a middle-aged woman sitting on a chair, body slightly turned to the left, head en face. Hands crossed on the chest. Wearing a white dress with a lace collar, on her head a white lace bonnet with blue ribbons.

7550.d: Toolil istuva vana mehe poolfiguur en face. Kaelas valge kaelarätt. Seljas kaherealine sinine metallnööpidega kuub.
7550.de: Half-figure of an old man sitting on a chair, en face. White neckerchief around his neck. Wearing a double-breasted blue coat with metal buttons.

7712.d: Majade taustal, lagedal platsil, monument. Taga paremal jõgi purjekaga. Platsil grupp inimesi. Monumendil tekst: AN. MDCCCXII MEMORABLE PAR LA CAMPAGE CONTRE LES RUSSES. VUETAPPROUVÉ BAD NOUS COMMAND RUSSE DE COBLENCE LE I: JANUIER 1814
7712.de: Against a background of houses, on an open square, a monument. Behind, on the right, a river with a sailboat. A group of people on the square. Text on the monument: AN. MDCCCXII MEMORABLE PAR LA CAMPAGE CONTRE LES RUSSES. VUETAPPROUVÉ BAD NOUS COMMAND RUSSE DE COBLENCE LE I: JANUIER 1814

7886.d: Vasakul Hermani ja üle jõe paremal taga Ivangorodi kindlus. Esiplaanil keskel rohelisel aasal kaks väikest mehe figuuri istumas. Vasakpoolne nendest sõjaväelane.
7886.de: On the left, Hermann Castle, and across the river on the right in the back, Ivangorod Fortress. In the centre foreground, on a green meadow, two small male figures sitting. The one on the left is a soldier.

8549.d: Esiplaanil oleva metsamassiivi keskelt paistab roosakas katus valge suitseva korstnaga. Sellest vasakul mäe nõlva tagant paistab punase katusega maja punase väravaga. Metsamassiivi tagant kerkib Tallinna linna panoraam, millest paremal pool Toompea koos linnusega, vasakul pool meri.
8549.de: From the middle of the forest mass in the foreground a pinkish roof with a white smoking chimney can be seen. To its left, behind the slope of a hill, a house with a red roof and a red gate is visible. Behind the forest mass rises the panorama of the city of Tallinn, with Toompea and its castle on the right, and the sea on the left.

8799.d: Keskealise mehe portree kerges pöördes vasakule. Tumedad juuksed, põskhabe. Tume kuub, beež vest, valge kaelaside.
8799.de: Portrait of a middle-aged man in a slight turn to the left. Dark hair, side-whiskers. Dark coat, beige waistcoat, white necktie.

8836.d: Esiplaanil karjamaa, vasakul suured kivid, karjapoiss; keskel põõsad; taga Toompea nõlvak Toomkiriku ja Pika Hermaniga.
8836.de: In the foreground, a pasture, on the left large stones, a shepherd boy; in the middle bushes; behind, the slope of Toompea with the Cathedral Church and Pikk Hermann.

9054.d: Esiplaanil vasakust nurgast diagonaalselt paremale orgu läbiv kivine müür. Müüri taga paremalt diagonaalselt sügavusse suunduv linnamüür ümmarguste tornidega. Müüri taga telliskatusega majad ja Oleviste kiriku torn. Linna müürist vasakul alumisest nurgast sügavusse kulgeb siksaki kujuline nõlvak.
9054.de: In the foreground, a stone wall running diagonally from the left corner to the right through a valley. Behind the wall, a city wall with round towers running diagonally from the right into the depth. Behind the wall, houses with tiled roofs and the tower of St. Olaf's Church (Oleviste). To the left of the city wall, a zigzag-shaped slope runs from the lower corner into the depth.

9359.d: Esiplaanil keskel põlvili naine, kelle ümber neli last. Nii paremal kui vasakul üks naisefiguur. Taevas inglid ja putod. Keskel Maria Jeesus-lapsega. Nurgad pronksitud.
9359.de: In the front centre a kneeling woman, surrounded by four children. On both the right and the left, one female figure. In the sky, angels and putti. In the centre, Mary with the infant Jesus. Corners bronzed.

9373.de: Branch of summer carnation with red flowers.

9626.d: Keset lehte paelaga kokkusõlmitud lilleoksad. Vasakpoolse õie kohal helesinine liblikas.
9626.de: In the middle of the sheet flower branches tied together with a ribbon. Above the flower on the left a light blue butterfly.

10834.d: Noore daami rindportree poolprofiilis vasakule. Portreteeritu pruunid juuksed on sätitud tihedate lokkidega soengusse, otsmikul paistab punakas peapael. Seljas must kõrge kaeluse ja puhvis varrukatega kleit. Taustal rannamaastik ja sinakas-lillakas taevahorisont.
10834.de: Bust portrait of a young lady in half-profile to the left. The sitter's brown hair is arranged in a hairstyle of dense curls, a reddish headband shows on the forehead. Wearing a black dress with a high collar and puffed sleeves. In the background a coastal landscape and a bluish-purple horizon sky.

25482.d: Maastik suurtest looduslikest kivirahnudest, ümarkaarsete avadega, silindervõlvidega hoone varemetega. Vasakul ees kivirahnude hunnik. Esiplaanil istub maas kaabuga karjane, tema kõrval koer. Ees veel kaks lehma, paremal taga ka kaks lehma. Varemete ees söövad rohtu kolm lammast. Paremal horisondil mäetipp, sellest eespool metsaga künkad ja linnalaadne asula.(eesti)
25482.de: A landscape of large natural boulders, with ruins of a building with round-arched openings and cylindrical vaults. On the left in front, a heap of boulders. In the foreground a shepherd with a hat sits on the ground, beside him a dog. In front two more cows, on the right further back also two cows. In front of the ruins three sheep graze on grass. On the right, on the horizon, a mountain peak, in front of it hills with forest and a town-like settlement.
